en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Fazzal, from Ali Bin Uqba, from his father, from Zurara, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> that
Suleyman<sup>as</sup> Bin Dawood<sup>as</sup> performed Hajj of the House (Kaaba) among the Jinn and the humans, and the birds, and the winds, and a cloak of the household tapestries’.
en.sarwar: 6. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from ibn Faddal from Ali ibn ‘Uqbah, from his father from Zurarah who has said the following: “Abu Ja’far, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
Sulayman son of Dawud (Solomon son of David) performed Hajj along with Jinn, man, bird and wind, wearing a Coptic gown.’”
